title: 聽懂愛爾蘭式互虧
subtitle: 12 句英文，被虧不再只會說對不起

lines.say: Well, look who it is! Did you get dressed in the dark, Jay?
lines.zh: 喲，看看誰來了！Jay，你是摸黑穿衣服的嗎？

lines.say: …What? Is something wrong with my clothes? I'm sorry…
lines.zh: ……什麼？我的衣服有問題嗎？對不起……

lines.say: This is Jay. He's from Taiwan. His Irish friend Conor just insulted his shirt. And Jay is upset.
lines.zh: 這是 Jay，他從台灣來。他的愛爾蘭朋友 Conor 剛剛虧他的襯衫，Jay 很受傷。

lines.say: But here's the secret. In Ireland, if someone teases you, it usually means they like you.
lines.zh: 但秘密是：在愛爾蘭，如果有人虧你，通常代表他喜歡你。

board.cta: 聽懂愛爾蘭式互虧・12 句

lines.say: Hi everyone, I'm Neev! Today, Jay will learn twelve sentences for Irish banter.
lines.zh: 哈囉大家，我是 Niamh 老師！今天 Jay 要學愛爾蘭式互虧的十二句話。
lines.cap: Hi everyone, I'm Niamh! Today, Jay will learn twelve sentences for Irish banter.

lines.say: Recognising a joke, hitting back, Irish ways of saying things, and what to do if you go too far.
lines.zh: 聽出玩笑、虧回去、愛爾蘭人特有的說法，還有開玩笑過頭時怎麼辦。

lines.say: Part one: is it a joke?
lines.zh: 第一段：這是玩笑嗎？

lines.say: Banter is friendly teasing. In Ireland, it's how friends show they're close.
lines.zh: banter 是友善的互虧。在愛爾蘭，這是朋友表示親近的方式。

lines.say: Are you slagging me?
Slagging is the Irish word for teasing. It's not the same as insulting.
lines.zh: slagging 是愛爾蘭人說的取笑，跟侮辱不一樣。

lines.say: Say it with a smile, and you've already won half the game.
lines.zh: 笑著說，你就已經贏一半了。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Are you slagging me?

scenes.label: No. 2
scenes.phrase: Relax, I'm only pulling your leg.
scenes.note: pull someone's leg ＝ 開某人玩笑

lines.say: And this is what they'll say back.
lines.zh: 對方通常會這樣回。

lines.say: Relax, I'm only pulling your leg.
Pulling your leg means joking. Nobody meant it seriously.
lines.zh: pulling your leg 是開玩笑，沒人當真。

lines.say: When you hear this, you know: it was banter, not a fight.
lines.zh: 聽到這句你就知道：這是互虧，不是吵架。

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: Relax, I'm only pulling your leg.

scenes.label: No. 3
scenes.phrase: Don't take it personally. It means he likes you.
scenes.meaning: 別往心裡去，這代表他喜歡你
scenes.note: take it personally ＝ 往心裡去

lines.say: And if a friend gets upset, explain it like this.
lines.zh: 如果朋友不開心了，就這樣解釋。

lines.say: Don't take it personally. It means he likes you.
Don't take it personally means: it's not really about you.
lines.zh: Don't take it personally 意思是：這不是真的針對你。

lines.say: In Ireland, people only slag the people they're comfortable with.
lines.zh: 在愛爾蘭，大家只虧自己熟的人。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Don't take it personally. It means he likes you.
Part two: hit back.
lines.zh: 第二段：虧回去。

lines.say: If someone slags you, saying sorry is the worst answer. They want you to play!
lines.zh: 被虧時說對不起是最糟的回答。他們想要你一起玩！

scenes.label: No. 4
scenes.meaning: 你還敢說，看看你那個髮型！

lines.say: Says you, with that haircut!
Says you means: you can't criticise me, you're no better.
lines.zh: Says you 意思是：你沒資格說我，你也好不到哪裡去。

lines.say: Add something about them. Keep it light. Hair is always safe.
lines.zh: 再加一點關於對方的事，輕鬆就好。髮型永遠是安全牌。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Says you, with that haircut!

scenes.label: No. 5
scenes.meaning: 這話從你嘴裡說出來還真好笑！

lines.say: Another way to hit back.
lines.zh: 另一種虧回去的方法。

lines.say: That's rich, coming from you!
That's rich means: you're the last person who should say that.
lines.zh: That's rich 是「你最沒資格說這句話」。

lines.say: If he says you're always late, and he's even later? That's rich!
lines.zh: 如果他說你總是遲到，但他更遲？That's rich！

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: That's rich, coming from you!

scenes.label: No. 6
scenes.note: You're one to talk ＝ 你還好意思說

lines.say: And the shortest one.
lines.zh: 最短的一句。

lines.say: You're one to talk!
Same meaning, and very quick. Perfect when you need an answer fast.
lines.zh: 意思一樣，而且很短。需要快速回嘴時超好用。

lines.say: Timing is everything. Say it straight away, with a grin.
lines.zh: 時機就是一切。馬上說，帶點壞笑。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: You're one to talk!
Let's try the pub again. Jay, you're ready.
lines.zh: 我們重來一次 Pub 那段。Jay，你準備好了。

lines.say: Well, look who it is! Did you get dressed in the dark, Jay?
lines.zh: 喲，看看誰來了！Jay，你是摸黑穿衣服的嗎？

lines.say: Are you slagging me? Says you, with that haircut!
lines.zh: 你是在虧我嗎？你還敢說，看看你那個髮型！

lines.say: Ha! Relax, I'm only pulling your leg.
lines.zh: 哈！放輕鬆，我只是在逗你。

lines.say: I know. You're one to talk, though. You've worn that jumper all week!
lines.zh: 我知道。不過你還好意思講，那件毛衣你穿一整週了！

lines.say: Look at Conor's face. Jay has passed the test!
lines.zh: 看 Conor 的表情，Jay 通過考驗了！

scenes.title: Irish ways
scenes.sub: 愛爾蘭說法：話要反著聽

lines.say: Part three: Irish ways of saying things.
lines.zh: 第三段：愛爾蘭人特有的說法。

lines.say: Irish people often say the opposite of what they mean. You need a decoder!
lines.zh: 愛爾蘭人常常說反話，你需要一台解碼器！

scenes.label: No. 7
scenes.note: not the worst ＝ 其實很好

lines.say: It's not the worst.
It's not the worst actually means: it's really good!
lines.zh: It's not the worst 其實是說：這很棒！

lines.say: Irish people don't like to sound too excited. So they say less.
lines.zh: 愛爾蘭人不喜歡聽起來太激動，所以會少說一點。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: It's not the worst.

scenes.label: No. 8
scenes.note: Would you stop! ＝ 別鬧了（被稱讚時）

lines.say: And when someone gives you a compliment, this is the answer.
lines.zh: 被稱讚時，這就是標準回答。

lines.say: Ah, would you stop!
Would you stop! means: you're embarrassing me, but thank you.
lines.zh: Would you stop! 是「你害我不好意思了，但謝謝」。

lines.say: Irish people find it hard to just say thank you to a compliment.
lines.zh: 愛爾蘭人很難直接對讚美說謝謝。

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: Ah, would you stop!

scenes.label: No. 9
scenes.phrase: Go on, go on, go on. Just one more.
scenes.meaning: 來嘛來嘛來嘛，再一個就好

lines.say: And the famous Irish way to insist.
lines.zh: 還有愛爾蘭人出名的勸說方式。

lines.say: Go on, go on, go on. Just one more.
Go on, said three times, means: I won't take no for an answer.
lines.zh: Go on 說三次，意思是：我不接受拒絕。

lines.say: Usually about one more cup of tea, or one more biscuit. You will always say yes.
lines.zh: 通常是再一杯茶或再一塊餅乾，而你最後一定會答應。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Go on, go on, go on. Just one more.

scenes.title: Too far?
scenes.sub: 開玩笑過頭時：怎麼救回來

lines.say: Part four: when a joke goes too far.
lines.zh: 第四段：玩笑開過頭時。

lines.say: Even the Irish get it wrong sometimes. The important thing is to fix it fast.
lines.zh: 連愛爾蘭人有時也會開過頭。重點是要快點補救。

scenes.label: No. 10
scenes.phrase: Sorry, I didn't mean it like that.
scenes.note: mean it like that ＝ 是那個意思

lines.say: Sorry, I didn't mean it like that.
If someone looks hurt, stop joking and say this.
lines.zh: 如果對方看起來受傷了，就別再鬧，說這句。

lines.say: Say it simply, and look at them. No more jokes for a minute.
lines.zh: 簡單地說，看著對方，接下來一分鐘別再開玩笑。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Sorry, I didn't mean it like that.

scenes.label: No. 11
scenes.note: come out wrong ＝ 說出來的話跟本意不同

lines.say: Or when your words sound worse than you meant.
lines.zh: 或者當你的話聽起來比本意更糟。

lines.say: That came out wrong.
That came out wrong means: the words were bad, but my meaning wasn't.
lines.zh: That came out wrong 是：話說得不好，但我本意不是那樣。

lines.say: Very useful when you're joking in your second language!
lines.zh: 用第二語言開玩笑時超好用！

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: That came out wrong.

scenes.label: No. 12
scenes.phrase: Fair enough, I'll give you that one.
scenes.note: I'll give you that ＝ 這點我承認

lines.say: And when they win the round, admit it.
lines.zh: 對方這回合贏了，就大方承認。

lines.say: Fair enough, I'll give you that one.
I'll give you that one means: OK, your joke was better. You win this time.
lines.zh: I'll give you that one 是：好啦，你的笑話比較好，這次你贏。

lines.say: Losing well is part of banter too.
lines.zh: 輸得漂亮也是互虧的一部分。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Fair enough, I'll give you that one.
Jay, you look great tonight, actually.
lines.zh: Jay，說真的，你今晚很帥。

lines.say: Ah, would you stop!
lines.zh: 哎呀，別鬧了啦！

lines.say: Another drink? Go on, go on, go on.
lines.zh: 再一杯？來嘛來嘛來嘛。

lines.say: No, I'm driving. You'd know that if you ever listened!
lines.zh: 不行，我要開車。你有在聽我說話就會知道！

lines.say: Ha! Fair enough, I'll give you that one.
lines.zh: 哈！好吧，這一回算你贏。

lines.say: Listen to Jay. He sounds like he grew up in Dublin.
lines.zh: 聽聽 Jay，聽起來像在都柏林長大的。

scenes.title: Only in Ireland
scenes.sub: 愛爾蘭限定：互虧必備兩句

lines.say: One more thing! Two words you'll hear in every round of banter.
lines.zh: 還有加碼！每一輪互虧都會聽到的兩個字。

lines.say: This is the most common friendly insult in Ireland.
lines.zh: 這是愛爾蘭最常見的友善罵人話。

lines.say: Ya eejit!
Eejit is the Irish way to say idiot. Between friends, it's almost a compliment.
lines.zh: eejit 是愛爾蘭版的 idiot。朋友之間說，幾乎算是讚美。

lines.say: And when the joke is on you, and your face goes red, say this.
lines.zh: 被虧到臉紅時，就說這句。

lines.say: I was mortified!
Mortified means extremely embarrassed. Irish people use it for everything, big or small.
lines.zh: mortified 是尷尬到極點。愛爾蘭人大小事都用這個字。

lines.say: I was mortified!
Now the whole night at the pub. Say Jay's lines!
lines.zh: 現在把 Pub 的一整晚演一遍。跟著唸 Jay 的台詞！

lines.say: Look who it is! Did you get dressed in the dark?
lines.zh: 看看誰來了！你是摸黑穿衣服的嗎？

lines.say: Are you slagging me? That's rich, coming from you!
lines.zh: 你是在虧我嗎？這話從你嘴裡說出來還真好笑！

lines.say: Ha! I'm only pulling your leg. How was the new job?
lines.zh: 哈！我只是在逗你。新工作怎麼樣？

lines.say: It's not the worst. But I called my boss mum on the first day. I was mortified!
lines.zh: 還不賴。但我第一天叫我老闆「媽」，我尷尬死了！

lines.say: Ya eejit!
lines.zh: 你這個笨蛋！

lines.say: Says you! Fair enough, I'll give you that one.
lines.zh: 你還敢說！好吧，這一回算你贏。

items: Relax, I'm only pulling your leg.
Don't take it personally. It means he likes you.
Go on, go on, go on. Just one more.
Sorry, I didn't mean it like that.
Fair enough, I'll give you that one.

lines.say: Jay, you're a natural! Smile, hit back, and know when to stop.
lines.zh: Jay，你天生就會！微笑、虧回去，還知道什麼時候該停。

lines.say: Here are all twelve. Screenshot them, and try one on your Irish friends.
lines.zh: 十二句都在這裡。截圖下來，對你的愛爾蘭朋友試一句。

lines.zh: 走之前！想每天都練一點英文嗎？

lines.say: Try BinBin. Every day, there's a short news story from where you live, with the hard words explained.
lines.zh: 試試 BinBin。每天一則你所在地區的短新聞，難的單字都有解釋。

lines.say: Then play quick word games, on your own or with your friends.
lines.zh: 接著玩快速的單字小遊戲，自己玩或約朋友一起。

lines.say: Keep your streak going, unlock new titles, and say hi to other learners in the plaza.
lines.zh: 保持連續打卡、解鎖新稱號，還能在廣場跟其他學習者打招呼。

lines.zh: App 裡還有更多像這樣的英文小教室。

lines.zh: 上 binbindaily.com，或點下面的連結。
lines.cap: Go to binbindaily.com, or tap the link below.

lines.say: And if anyone slags your English? Says you! See you next time. Bye!
lines.zh: 如果有人虧你的英文？你還敢說！下一課見，Bye！
